faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Laser-Engraved Minimalist Silver Cufflinks?

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Laser-Engraved Minimalist Silver Cufflinks, and when is it waived?

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Laser-Engraved Minimalist Silver Cufflinks?

faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Mirror Rhodium / Brushed Steel / Gold. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Laser-Engraved Minimalist Silver Cufflinks?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Laser-Engraved Minimalist Silver Cufflinks completes in 7–10 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Laser-Engraved Minimalist Silver Cufflinks meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.
